title: Keep Panes and Panels Visible During Resize
description: When resizing panes and panels they disappear. This is not a canvas interaction — make sure everything remains visible during pane/panel edge resize. Ghost mode currently begins on PanelResizeHandle drag and automatic ghosting can also hide Pane chrome because resize handles are not nested data-dim controls. Fix so resize never ghost-dims chrome; everything stays visible. Extend existing tests.
summary:
Pane/panel disappearance during resize was caused by ghost mode, not canvas picking or size-collapse. PanelResizeHandle explicitly called panelGhost.begin(), and automatic ghosting also treated bare resize handles as canvas-like interactions, so data-ghost CSS set all data-dim chrome to opacity 0.

Fix:
1. Removed panelGhost begin/end from PanelResizeHandle — edge resize is layout, not a ghost session.
2. Added isChromeResizeHandleTarget() and exempted panel/pane/mode/window-measures resize slots (and resizable-corner) from shouldBeginAutomaticGhostInteraction.
3. Tagged panel handles with data-slot="panel-resize-handle".
4. Extended ghost + panel/pane resize tests under GhostProvider so chrome stays unghosted while size still updates.

Verified: 8 related vitest cases pass (ghost exemptions, panel/pane resize-under-GhostProvider, existing size math).
